request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund UTxO RPC by TxPipe: Maintaining Cardano's Integration Standard, Year 2

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve and a 15,750 ADA Intersect administration fee, totaling 540,750 ADA.
UTxO RPC is an open interface specification for UTxO-based blockchains using Protocol Buffers and SDKs in Rust, Go, Node.js, .NET, Haskell, and Python.
UTxO RPC has been adopted by Amaru, Dingo, and the Haskell Cardano node as a query interface or ecosystem standard.
The project maintains more than 10 repositories covering the core specification, SDKs, documentation, and provider integrations, and is open source under Apache 2.0.
The funded work would cover specification maintenance, SDK maintenance, community support, and AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain submission under the approved framework.
The requested withdrawal does not, at submission, individually or in aggregate breach the 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.

Intersect states that independent oversight and milestone-based disbursement controls will be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties using the Sundae Labs treasury management smart contract framework.
The document identifies specific TRSC and PSSC addresses, role thresholds, oversight committee entities, external references, and a dashboard for community audit and on-chain verification.

summary: The document describes a 540,750 ADA treasury withdrawal administered by Intersect to fund 12 months of UTxO RPC maintenance by TxPipe, with stated deliverables, budget composition, governance-process references, NCL compliance claims, prior funding disclosure, smart-contract custody details, and oversight mechanisms.
